scaleBeatText: ⛓️ Stonebridge doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.
With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 9,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.
🗣️ Valeria to David, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"
Almost nobody walks away from this one.

With Haven grieving, Ashford installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
🗣️ Meera to Sofia, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"
Almost nobody walks away from this one.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Ashford's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Ashford installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/8/3), with 3 wave-4 fought, 8 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.

doorOffer.promptHtml: The ring of pale light. The too-many-angled faces. The trillions of eyes. The ring waits. Seven doors — some open, some priced beyond you. The choice is which risk you take. ◈ the Feared — 29 distinct monsters faced blow-by-blow. The footage exists, and it plays unasked. (standing: 100) ◇ the Indispensable — The Indispensable needs a full seat — the galaxy must actually need you, not just notice you. ◈ the Beloved — Viewership 35, fan favor 43 — the galaxy's favorite, by the numbers. (standing: 100) ◈ the Witness — 3 exposures on the record. The docket is real. (standing: 49) ◈ the Assimilated — Always open. The table takes anyone — that's what makes it a trap, and what makes it safe. (standing: 60) ◈ the Defiant — Defiance 4 on the record. The 'no' is earned. (standing: 36) ◈ the Relay —
